findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_page, run_op, run_pipeline, read_handle, save_recipe · Private data: discover_ops, run_recipe, save_recipe, delete_recipe · Public sink: run_op, save_recipe, delete_recipe · Destructive: read_page, calculate_date, read_package_info, run_op, run_pipeline, read_handle, run_recipe, save_recipe, delete_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_page, run_op, run_pipeline, read_handle, save_recipe · Private data: discover_ops, run_recipe, save_recipe, delete_recipe · Public sink: run_op, save_recipe, delete_recipe · Destructive: read_page, calculate_date, read_package_info, run_op, run_pipeline, read_handle, run_recipe, save_recipe, delete_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
